independence_notes: CDC clinical and basics are one authoring group. ACEP summary and original policy are one group, not two sources.
NHS and UKHSA are separately authored but UKHSA links NHS; shared national emergency advice is disclosed. German rescue guideline supplies separate consensus authorship.
DIVI includes multiple societies but constitutes one consensus document; its special votes are not extra independent sources. GMS and PMC mirrors are the same document.

DIVI references prior ACEP 2017 policy, Weaver 2009, Hampson 2012 and CO/HBOT research. Thus authoring independence does not imply disjoint upstream trials. ACEP 2025 full references were not read; precise shared-trial inventory remains unknown.
CDC lists its 2024 archive rather than a full study-level bibliography; do not assert upstream trial independence.
